$comment: Names the verify command for this repo, which arms the guardrails plugin's
Stop gate: an agent may not declare itself done on a red build.
The gate is opt-in by design and stays inert until CLAUDE_GUARDRAILS_VERIFY
is set, because a Stop hook that guesses a verify command would block every
turn in every repo that hasn't got one. Scoping it here rather than in
~/.claude/settings.json is the point -- it applies exactly where a real
scripts/verify.sh is the local mirror of .github/workflows/checks.yml, so
the same bar gates an agent, a push, and a PR. ~11s, deterministic, free.
